arapca: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
mealTr: And olsun Allah yolunda koştukça koşanlara;

mealEn: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

mealFr: et font ainsi voler la poussière,

mealEn: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
mealDe: die dann mitten in die Ansammlung eindringen!
mealFr: et pénètrent au centre de la troupe ennemie.

mealTr: İnsan gerçekten Rabbine karşı pek nankördür.
mealEn: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
mealDe: Der Mensch ist seinem Herrn gegenüber wahrlich undankbar,
mealFr: L'homme est, certes, ingrat envers son Seigneur;

mealTr: Doğrusu kendisi de bunların hepsine şahittir.
mealEn: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
mealDe: und er (selbst) ist darüber wahrlich Zeuge.
mealFr: et pourtant, il est certes, témoin de cela;

mealEn: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
mealDe: Und er ist in seiner Liebe zum (eigenen) Besten wahrlich heftig.
mealFr: et pour l'amour des richesses il est certes ardent.

arapca: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
mealTr: İnsan, kabirlerde bulunanların çıkarılacağı ve kalblerde olanların ortaya konulacağı bir zamanın geleceğini bilmez mi?
mealEn: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
mealDe: Weiß er denn nicht? Wenn durchwühlt wird, was in den Gräbern ist,
mealFr: Ne sait-il donc pas que lorsque ce qui est dans les tombes sera bouleversé,

mealTr: İnsan, kabirlerde bulunanların çıkarılacağı ve kalblerde olanların ortaya konulacağı bir zamanın geleceğini bilmez mi?
mealEn: And that within the breasts is obtained,
mealDe: und herausgeholt wird, was in den Brüsten ist,...
mealFr: et que sera dévoilé ce qui est dans les poitrines,

mealTr: Doğrusu Rableri o gün onların her şeyinden haberdardır.
mealEn: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
mealDe: ihr Herr wird an jenem Tag ihrer wahrlich Kundig sein.
mealFr: ce jour-là, certes, leur Seigneur sera Parfaitement Connaisseur d'eux?
